frames.title: 1  Glue the two deck keys into the base
frames.caption:
Print the base and two Cubware deck keys. Superglue each key's
triangular nub into its 2.1 mm pocket under the base.

frames.title: 2  Press in eight M3 heat-set inserts
frames.caption:
M3 x 5.7 mm brass inserts, with a soldering iron:
four in the fan posts, four in the corner posts.

frames.title: 3  Drop in the XIAO RP2040, wired to the fan
frames.caption:
USB-C goes into the notch in the wall. The rails and the stop
locate it; the fan above keeps it from lifting.

frames.title: 4  Seat the 40 mm fan, rotor side up
frames.caption:
40 x 40 x 10 mm fan on the four posts, label (rotor) side up,
cable toward the XIAO.

frames.title: 5  Four M3 x 16 screws through the fan
frames.caption: Into the post inserts. Snug only: the fan frame is plastic.

frames.title: 6  Magnets into the carrier, carrier onto the hub
frames.caption:
Two 1/4 x 1/8 in N52 discs, 12 mm apart: red = north up, blue = south up.
CA glue; centre the carrier on the hub.

frames.title: 7  Lower the vial holder over the fan
frames.caption:
The magnets turn in a 35 mm pocket, 1 mm under a 1.2 mm printed floor.
The vial sits on that floor.

frames.title: 8  Four M3 x 12 screws through the flange
frames.caption: Into the corner-post inserts.

frames.title: 9  Set the module on the CubXL deck
frames.caption:
The keys drop into two adjacent slots, 25 mm apart. Slip fit held by gravity,
like Cubware's holders. The vial axis sits midway between the two slot columns.

frames.title: 10  Stir bar into the vial, vial into the holder
frames.caption:
15 x 6 mm PTFE bar. Three crush ribs in the bore grip the 28 mm vial
so the capper can twist the cap.

frames.title: Assembled
frames.caption:
56 x 56 mm footprint, 49.5 mm tall without the vial. Vial bottom 24.4 mm
and vial rim ~81 mm above the deck.

frames.title: Exploded view
frames.caption:
Printed: base, vial holder, magnet carrier, 2 deck keys. Bought: fan, XIAO RP2040,
2 magnets, stir bar, 8 M3 inserts, 4 M3 x 16 and 4 M3 x 12 socket head screws.

frames.title: Section through the vial axis
frames.caption:
Magnet top to the vial's inside floor: 1.0 mm gap + 1.2 mm print + ~1.6 mm glass
= ~3.8 mm. Bar axis ~6.8 mm above the magnets.
